scope: Actual explicit GB10 API, NoGrad attention forward; full 48-SM GB10, B1/H16/D128 FP16/BF16, dense and causal S128/S512/S1024/S4096. No model or backward speedup claim.
publication_source_equivalence: Published after fast-forward to publication_base; measured GB10/native/CUDA/API sources remain byte-identical, with hashes retained.
precision: Existing shifted-score forward; no kernel-body or training arithmetic change. Independent per-head FP64 norm limit 1% BF16 / 0.5% FP16. FA2/SDPA retain their own arithmetic.

flash_attention.layout_adapter: BHSD views to BSHD and back

protocol.timing: Graph CUDA events divided by 32 real captured calls; eager complete warmed wall time. Rotate order; preparation and allocation included, compilation/capture/profile construction excluded. Profiling occurs after timings.

limitations: S128 BF16 dense eager may trail SDPA despite graph improvement; retain samples.
Graph gains largely reflect forward implementation selection; matched geometry statistics omission alone yields small device changes.
No performance-counter-derived occupancy/stall/bandwidth claims. Kernel resources and static instruction sites are not runtime utilization.
Short public eager calls include several microseconds of Python selector cost visible in the raw-inference control.
Unchanged training schedules and ordinary fallback behavior are retained; no backward performance claim.
